title: Offline Reinforcement Learning for Distribution-Grid Protection
abstract: arXiv:2609.24703v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data-driven protection may complement conventional relays in distribution grids whose operating conditions vary with distributed generation, switching events, and changing short-circuit levels. We study line-selective tripping from static trajectories of a realistically simulated CIGRE medium-voltage network using offline reinforcement learning. A convolutional Q-network receives causal voltage-current phasor and apparent-impedance features, optionally together with raw waveforms, and is trained with conservative Q-learning (CQL). A controlled sensitivity study evaluates two observation windows, reward variants, and three CQL weights under a common split and training protocol; one exploratory post-hoc run additionally increases the discount factor from $\gamma$=0.95 to 0.99. On 225 held-out episodes, the best per-timestep result is obtained with combined input and CQL weight $\alpha$=0.9, reaching precision 0.9993, recall 0.9496, and F

translated_title: 面向配电网保护的离线强化学习
translated_abstract: 数据驱动的保护方法可以在配电网中补充传统继电器，因为配电网的运行条件会随着分布式发电、开关操作事件和短路水平的变化而变化。我们使用离线强化学习，从真实模拟的CIGRE中压网络的静态轨迹中研究线路选择性跳闸问题。卷积Q网络接收因果电压-电流相量和视在阻抗特征，可选地结合原始波形，并采用保守Q学习（CQL）进行训练。一项受控敏感性研究在统一的划分和训练协议下评估了两种观测窗口、奖励变体和三种CQL权重；此外，一次探索性的事后运行将折扣因子从γ=0.95提高到0.99。在225个保留测试回合中，使用组合输入和CQL权重α=0.9获得了最佳的单步结果，精确率达到0.9993，召回率达到0.9496。
tldr: 该论文利用离线强化学习（保守Q学习）训练卷积Q网络，从模拟CIGRE中压配电网的静态轨迹数据中学习线路选择性跳闸保护策略，在225个测试回合中达到0.9993的精确率和0.9496的召回率。
en_tdlr: This paper trains a convolutional Q-network with offline reinforcement learning (conservative Q-learning) to learn line-selective tripping protection from static trajectories of a simulated CIGRE medium-voltage distribution grid, achieving 0.9993 precision and 0.9496 recall on 225 held-out episodes.
